_comment: IATA 2-letter airline codes whose primary hub is OUTSIDE the Schengen Area and the UK, so a connection there does not require a Schengen/UK Airport Transit Visa for a Moroccan passport holder. The free flight-price API used by this app does NOT report the actual layover airport, only the airline and stop count - this allowlist is a heuristic safeguard, not a guarantee. ALWAYS double-check the actual routing on the booking site before paying, especially for airlines not in this list (which are blocked from connections by default because many European/UK carriers hub through Schengen or the UK).

safe_hub_airlines.TK: Turkish Airlines - hubs Istanbul (IST), not Schengen/UK
safe_hub_airlines.PC: Pegasus Airlines - hubs Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen (SAW), not Schengen/UK
safe_hub_airlines.AT: Royal Air Maroc - Moroccan carrier, mostly direct/own hub (CMN)
